column4: nice-dns install puts nice-dns-gui, its launcher and its icon on the host; --check exits 0 naming the generation
nice-dns-gui --screenshot in the user's graphical session writes the PNG the run fetched
nice-dns-gui --run-action restart --exit in the session returns 0 and DNS answers
nice-dns-gui --run-action update-check --exit in the session returns 0 or 10
nice-dns uninstall removes the program, the launcher, the icon and the GUI's files
nice-dns install after the uninstall puts the GUI and the stack back
